description: Ajust is an Australian consumer advocacy service that helps people resolve problems with businesses such as refunds, billing disputes, cancellations, and complaints. It offers AI-guided consumer help and a partner backend API for approved integrations.
summary: Public MCP servers at `agent.ajust.com.au` (Claude and ChatGPT endpoints) plus a partner-only HTTP API at `api.ajust.com.au` using OAuth 2.0 client credentials bearer tokens.
